ownerDescription: The Muslim Community of Edmonton (MCE) Mosque evolved from the Muslim Students' Association (MSA) of the University of Alberta in the 1980's. Around 60 university students used to pray at the U of A as the Al Rashid Mosque was quite far. Functions were limited to Fridays. A group of students decided they needed a Da'wah (outreach) centre near the university that would cater to the university/downtown area. They formed the MCE Mosque religious society to build the mosque and Islamic centre. The land was purchased on 86 Ave. & 107 St. in 1984, and was mainly funded from abroad. Construction of the building started with full participation from the community, which helped immensely in terms of monetary donations, labour and building supplies.

Suhbah Islamic Center is a welcoming mosque and Islamic community hub in Edmonton. "Suhbah" — meaning companionship in Arabic — reflects our mission: spiritual connection, brotherhood, and belonging for Muslims of all backgrounds.

We offer daily prayers, Jumu'ah, and programs built around six pillars: Da'wah & Remembrance · Tazkiyah (soul, Seerah & Tafseer majalis) · Lifelong Learning (Madrasah, Hifz, Arabic & youth programs) · A Real Home for Our Sisters (halaqas, Sahabiyaat series & Ramadan programs) · A Dedicated Space for Youth (deen & purpose) · Homeschooling Support for Muslim families (co-op days & resources).

Whether you are a Muslim or a truth-seeker, Suhbah is a home for all. Temporarily closed for construction — reopening soon.

reviews.text:
I recently visited the prayer space at Southeast Muslim Community Edmonton inside The Meadows Community Recreation Centre, and it was truly an amazing experience.
The space is peaceful, clean, and very well maintained. It provides a calm environment for salah, even within a busy recreation centre. I really appreciated how accessible it is for the Muslim community—especially for those who are already at the facility for sports or family activities.
The management and volunteers have done a great job creating a welcoming and respectful atmosphere. It’s beautiful to see a place where community, fitness, and faith come together so nicely.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for a convenient and serene place to pray in southeast Edmonton.
